title: 英文仿真卷 D（全科第5場）
subject: 英文

questions.stem: Before posting the recipe online, she asked me to ______ the flour on the kitchen scale.
questions.explain: weigh 為動詞「秤重」，與 scale（磅秤）搭配。wait 等待、wave 揮手、wear 穿戴，皆與量重無關。⚠ weigh（動詞）與 weight（名詞）常混——句中 me to ____ it 需要動詞，故用 weigh。

questions.stem: Please ______ me to water the plants before we leave; I always forget.
questions.explain: remind 為「提醒（某人）」，句型 remind sb to V。remember 是自己記得、memorize 是背誦記住、recall 是回想起來——三者主體都是自己，無法「提醒別人」。判斷動作：看到 ____ me to V，主體是別人在提醒我，用 remind。

questions.stem: The swimming pool is not ______ on Sundays, so you will have to go on Monday.
questions.explain: available 指「可獲得的、可利用的」，服務、商品、時段皆可用。capable 用於人「有能力的」（be capable of）、possible 修飾事情本身而非服務、reachable 指聯絡得上。此句主詞是 service，最自然者為 available。

questions.stem: The night market was so ______ last weekend that we could hardly walk.
questions.explain: 空格在 so ____ that 之間，需形容詞；crowded 為形容詞「擁擠的」。crowd 是名詞或動詞、crowds 是名詞複數、crowding 是動名詞或現在分詞，均不合此位置。判斷動作：**so ... that 中間放形容詞或副詞**。

questions.stem: Several neighbours ______ about the noise, so the café closed its terrace at ten.
questions.explain: complain about 為「抱怨某事」之固定搭配，與後句「經理加開櫃檯」因果相符。explain 解釋、contain 包含、remain 保持，皆與 about 搭配不自然且語意不合。

questions.stem: Because the violin was ______, he kept it in a locked case at all times.
questions.explain: valuable 指「貴重的、值錢的」，與「保價郵件」相符。⚠ 三個誘答是陷阱：**invaluable 是「無價的、極珍貴的」**（in- 在此非否定，反而更強）、valueless 與 worthless 都是「毫無價值」。本題選 valuable 即可，但 invaluable 的字義要記住，真卷常以此設陷。

questions.stem: The online course is meant to ______ classroom teaching, not to take its place.
questions.explain: complement 為「補足、與……相輔相成」，與後半 not to take their place（不是取代）呼應。**compliment 是「稱讚」**——兩字僅一個字母之差，是你反覆錯過的一組。complicate 使複雜、compete 競爭，語意皆不合。判斷動作：看句子講的是「補足」還是「稱讚」。

questions.stem: It was ______ of him to copy the phone number without checking a single digit.
questions.explain: careless 為「粗心的」，與「沒查郵遞區號就寫地址」相符。careful 小心的（語意相反）、carefree 無憂無慮的、caring 關懷體貼的。⚠ 字尾 -less 表「缺少」、-ful 表「充滿」，是判斷方向的第一步。

questions.stem: The school will ______ the new timetable at the end of this month.
questions.explain: announce 為「宣布、公告」，受詞為 schedule（時程）相當自然。advance 推進、advise 建議（advise sb to V）、admire 欽佩，均不與 schedule 直接搭配。

questions.stem: Keep this number on your phone; you may need it in case of an ______.
questions.explain: in case of an emergency 為固定用法「萬一發生緊急狀況」。emphasis 強調、empire 帝國、employment 僱用——三者與 in case of 完全不搭。⚠ 這組 em- 開頭的形近字你錯過兩次（8/07、8/21），**判斷動作是先看整句在講什麼情境，再挑字，不要只看字首**。

questions.stem: Using a refillable bottle can greatly ______ the amount of plastic waste.
questions.explain: reduce 為「減少」，與 waste（廢棄物）搭配最合理。produce 生產、introduce 介紹引進、reproduce 複製繁殖——三者都是 -duce 家族，字形相近但語意不同。判斷動作：看句子要的是「變少」還是「做出來」。

questions.stem: After working here for ten years, she is quite ______ with every street in this district.
questions.explain: be familiar with 為「熟悉某事物」之固定搭配。similar 相似的（be similar to）、famous 有名的（be famous for）、formal 正式的。⚠ 三個誘答字形都接近，**分辨關鍵在後面接的介系詞**：familiar **with**、similar **to**、famous **for**。

questions.stem: The magazine has been in ______ for over fifty years and still sells well.
questions.explain: in publication 指「持續發行、出版中」，publication 為表示「發行」這個動作或事件的名詞。**publicity 是「宣傳、知名度」**、public 是形容詞或指大眾、publisher 是出版者（人）。⚠ 這組你錯過兩次，判斷動作：先問空格要的是**動作／事件**（publication）還是**宣傳**（publicity）。

questions.stem: This soil is not ______ for growing herbs; try a lighter one with more sand.
questions.explain: be suitable for 為「適合於」。possible 指事情有可能發生、capable 用於人或機器有能力、available 指可取得。此句主詞是 envelope（物），要表達「不適合」，用 suitable。⚠ suitable 正是 109 真卷考過的字，屬真卷難度層級。

questions.stem: He ______ watches television nowadays because almost everything is online.
questions.explain: seldom 為頻率副詞「很少」，與後句「幾乎都線上處理」相符。already 已經（語意不合）、always 總是（方向相反）、hardly ever than 不成句。⚠ seldom 本身已含否定意味，句中不再加 not。

questions.point: 文法：主詞動詞一致（a number of）
questions.stem: A number of residents ______ asked for an extra rubbish collection in summer.
questions.explain: **a number of** + 複數名詞＝「許多……」，中心語是後面的複數名詞 residents，故動詞用複數 have。⚠ 對照 **the number of** + 複數名詞＝「……的數目」，中心語是 the number（單數），動詞用 has。判斷動作：**看冠詞是 a 還是 the**——a number of 看後面的名詞，the number of 看 number 本身。

questions.point: 文法：關係代名詞 which 指前面整句
questions.stem: She missed the last bus, ______ meant she had to walk home in the rain.
questions.explain: 先行詞是**前面整個句子**（她錯過末班車這件事）時，關係代名詞用 **which**，且前面須有逗號（非限定用法）。that 不能引導非限定子句、what 本身含先行詞不能再有先行詞、it 是代名詞不能連接兩個子句。⚠ 真卷 112 第 25 題即考同一結構。

questions.point: 文法：比較句中的所有格
questions.stem: Her handwriting is much neater than ______.
questions.explain: 比較的兩造必須對等：Her handwriting（字跡）要對上 her sister's（＝her sister's handwriting），故用**所有格**代替重複的名詞。her sister 是人，與「字跡」不對等；her sister does 用於比較動作；D 選項句構重複。⚠ 真卷 112 第 27 題同型（as good as your mother's）。

questions.stem: This box is quite heavy. Would you mind ______ me carry it upstairs?
questions.explain: mind 之後接**動名詞**（V-ing），Would you mind V-ing? 為固定請求句型。⚠ 同類必接 V-ing 的動詞：enjoy、finish、avoid、practice、suggest、consider。真卷 112 第 22 題同型（Do you mind opening it?）。

questions.stem: ______ in line for an hour is not my idea of a good morning.
questions.explain: 句首缺主詞，動詞轉為名詞用法有兩種：動名詞（V-ing）或不定詞（to V）。此處 Waiting 為動名詞當主詞。Wait 是原形動詞不能當主詞、To waiting 文法不成立（to 之後不接 V-ing 作此用）、Waited 是過去式或過去分詞。⚠ 真卷 112 第 23 題同型。

questions.point: 文法：分詞構句（被動，主詞為物）
questions.stem: ______ with plenty of straw, the glass jars survived the journey without a single crack.
questions.explain: 分詞構句的邏輯主詞是 the glass vase（花瓶），花瓶是**被**包裝的，故用**過去分詞** Packed 表被動。Packing 是主動（花瓶自己包東西，不合理）、To pack 表目的、Being pack 文法錯誤。⚠⚠ **這個結構你已連續錯四次（8/18、8/20、8/21）**，判斷動作只有一步：**問「主詞是做這個動作，還是被做」——被做就用 p.p.**，主詞是物幾乎都是被做。

questions.stem: Many residents are fed up ______ having their bins emptied so late in the day.
questions.explain: be fed up **with** 為固定搭配，意為「受夠了、厭煩」，之後接名詞或動名詞。⚠ 真卷 112 第 29 題即考本片語。同類易混：be tired **of**、be bored **with/of**、be angry **about**（事）／**with**（人）。

questions.stem: It ______ about three days for a seed of this kind to sprout in warm soil.
questions.explain: 表「花費時間」用 **It takes + 時間 + for sb/sth + to V**。spend 的主詞須為**人**（He spends two hours...）、cost 主詞為**物**且用於花費**金錢**、need 語意不合此句型。⚠ 真卷 112 第 18 題同型。

questions.point: 文法：名詞子句之連接詞 how
questions.stem: It is hard to imagine ______ people managed to find their way before printed maps existed.
questions.explain: 空格引導名詞子句作 imagine 的受詞，子句 people managed to send messages 結構**完整**（主詞、動詞、受詞齊備），故需**副詞性**連接詞 how（方式）。which、what 均為代名詞性質，會使子句缺成分；whether 表「是否」，語意不合。⚠ 真卷 112 第 16 題同型。

questions.point: 文法：wish＋過去式（與現在事實相反）
questions.stem: This photograph has no date on the back. I wish there ______ some way to find out when it was taken.
questions.explain: wish 之後表**與現在事實相反**的願望，動詞用過去式；be 動詞在正式用法一律用 **were**（不分人稱）。is 是直述現在、will be 是單純未來、would have been 屬與**過去**事實相反。⚠ 真卷 112 第 19 題同型（I wish I could remember his name）。你 8/21 在此結構失分，本題改以 there be 句型與 were 測同一判準。

questions.point: 文法：when + 過去分詞（省略主詞與 be）
questions.stem: When ______ about the mistake, the waiter apologized at once and offered a refund.
questions.explain: 副詞子句與主句主詞相同（the clerk）時，可省略主詞與 be 動詞；店員是**被**詢問，故用過去分詞 asked（＝When he was asked）。asking 為主動、to ask 表目的、ask 為原形。⚠ 真卷 112 第 24 題同型（When told about the bad news...）。與第 21 題同一個判斷動作：主動還是被動。

questions.point: 文法：No sooner ... than 之倒裝
questions.stem: No sooner ______ the gates opened than a long line formed outside the hall.
questions.explain: No sooner ... than 表「一……就……」，No sooner 置句首須**倒裝**，且主要子句用**過去完成式**、than 子句用過去簡單式，故用 had（had the doors opened）。⚠ 同組倒裝結構一起記：**Hardly/Scarcely ... when**、**Not until ...**、**Had + S + p.p.（省略 if 的假設語氣）**。你 8/21 在倒裝連錯兩題，這一組要一次練完。

questions.stem: Few young people today seem to be interested ______ collecting coins.
questions.explain: be interested **in** 為固定搭配，之後接名詞或動名詞。⚠ 真卷 112 第 21 題同型（I'm not interested in any sports）。同類介系詞搭配：be good **at**、be famous **for**、be afraid **of**、be married **to**。

questions.point: 文法：過去簡單式與現在完成式之別
questions.stem: I ______ my old classmate at the market yesterday; we talked for almost an hour.
questions.explain: 句中有明確過去時間 **yesterday**，須用過去簡單式 met。現在完成式不與明確過去時間點連用；had met 為過去完成（需另一個更晚的過去時點）；have been meeting 為現在完成進行。⚠ 判斷動作：**先找時間副詞**——看到 yesterday／last week／ago，直接排除完成式。

questions.point: 文法：片語動詞 get on
questions.stem: The two researchers have worked together for years and ______ very well.
questions.explain: get on (well) with sb 為「相處融洽」。get over 克服、get up 起床、get through 通過或接通電話。⚠ 真卷 112 第 30 題同型。片語動詞要整組記，不能只看主動詞。

questions.stem:
【克漏字（一）】請依下文回答第 31～35 題。

Coffee was first cultivated in the highlands of Ethiopia and __31__ to the rest of the world by traders. Today it is grown in more than fifty countries, almost all of them in a narrow band __32__ the climate stays warm and wet for most of the year. Growing coffee, however, is not an easy business. Prices rise and fall sharply from season to season, and a single bad harvest can ruin a small farm. __33__, the number of growers continues to increase. Many are drawn by the high prices paid for specialty beans, __34__ these can sell for several times the price of ordinary coffee. Others simply have no better option, __35__ few other crops grow well at that altitude.

第 31 格：
questions.explain: 與前面 was cultivated 並列（Coffee was first cultivated ... and __ to the rest of the world），主詞 Coffee 是**被**帶到世界各地，故用被動 was carried。carrying 為主動分詞、has carried 為主動完成式、is carrying 為現在進行，皆與並列結構及被動語意不合。

questions.point: 克漏字一：關係副詞 where
questions.stem:

Many are drawn by the high prices paid for specialty beans, __34__ these can sell for several times the price of ordinary coffee. Others simply have no better option, __35__ few other crops grow well at that altitude.

第 32 格：
questions.explain: 先行詞 a narrow band 為**地點**，且後面子句 the climate stays warm 結構完整，故用關係副詞 where。which/that 為關係代名詞，會使子句缺主詞或受詞；what 不能有先行詞。判斷動作：先看子句缺不缺成分——不缺就用關係副詞。

questions.explain: 前句說「行情起伏大、一季歉收就能毀掉小農場」、後句說「種植戶仍持續增加」，前後**語意相反**，故用轉折語 Still（儘管如此）。Therefore 表結果、Similarly 表類比、Otherwise 表否則，方向皆不合。判斷動作：先讀前後兩句是順接還是逆接。

Coffee was first cultivated in the highlands of Ethiopia and __31__ to the rest of the world by traders. Today it is grown in more than fifty countries, almost all of them in a narrow band __32__ the climate stays warm and wet for most of the year. Growing coffee, however, is not an easy business. 第 34 格：
questions.explain: 空格前為「許多人被精品豆的高價吸引」，空格後為「這些豆子可賣到普通咖啡的數倍價錢」——後者是前者的**原因**，用 as（因為）。so 表結果（方向相反）、but 表轉折、or 表選擇。

questions.point: 克漏字一：原因連接詞 because
questions.stem:
【克漏字（一）】請依下文回答第 31～35 題。

Coffee was first cultivated in the highlands of Ethiopia and __31__ to the rest of the world by traders. Today it is grown in more than fifty countries, almost all of them in a narrow band __32__ the climate stays warm and wet for most of the year. Growing coffee, however, is not an easy business. Prices rise and fall sharply from season to season, and a single bad harvest can ruin a small farm. __33__, the number of growers continues to increase. Many are drawn by the high prices paid for specialty beans, __34__ these can sell for several times the price of ordinary coffee. Others simply have no better option, __35__ few other crops grow well at that altitude.

第 35 格：
questions.explain: 「別無更好的選擇」與「那個海拔幾乎種不了別的作物」是**因果**關係，用 because。although 表讓步、unless 表除非、whether 表是否。⚠ 本題與第 34 格同樣測因果，但四個選項中只有 because 成立。

questions.point: 克漏字二：關係代名詞主格
questions.stem:
【克漏字（二）】請依下文回答第 36～40 題。

Public libraries were once judged by the number of books on their shelves. Many are now measured by something else: the number of hours people spend inside them. A library card gives access to a quiet desk, a power socket, and a wireless network __36__ is free to everyone. The idea works __37__ the building stays open late enough to be useful; a library that closes at five in the afternoon serves almost nobody who has a job. Some critics argue that a library without books has lost its purpose, but so far the opposite __38__ true: branches that added desks and sockets also lent more books than before. The service matters most to __39__ who have no quiet room of their own. __40__ the shelves are shorter than they used to be, most libraries report more visitors than at any time in the past twenty years.

第 36 格：
questions.explain: 先行詞 a wireless network 是**物**，且後面子句 __ is free to everyone **缺主詞**，故用主格關係代名詞 which。where 為關係副詞（子句須完整）、whose 表所有格、what 不能有先行詞。判斷動作：**先看子句缺不缺主詞或受詞**——缺就用關係代名詞。

questions.point: 克漏字二：條件連接詞 as long as

The idea works __37__ the building stays open late enough to be useful; a library that closes at five in the afternoon serves almost nobody who has a job. Some critics argue that a library without books has lost its purpose, but so far the opposite __38__ true: branches that added desks and sockets also lent more books than before. The service matters most to __39__ who have no quiet room of their own. __40__ the shelves are shorter than they used to be, most libraries report more visitors than at any time in the past twenty years.

第 37 格：
questions.explain: 語意為「**只要**館舍開得夠晚，這個做法就行得通」，表**條件**，用 as long as。as far as 表範圍或程度（as far as I know）、as soon as 表時間「一……就……」、as well as 表「以及」。⚠ 這四個 as 開頭的片語你 8/21 在此失分，**判斷動作：先問這句在講條件、範圍、時間還是並列**。

questions.point: 克漏字二：主詞動詞一致
questions.stem:

The service matters most to __39__ who have no quiet room of their own. __40__ the shelves are shorter than they used to be, most libraries report more visitors than at any time in the past twenty years.

questions.point: 克漏字二：讓步連接詞 Although

【克漏字（二）】請依下文回答第 36～40 題。

A library card gives access to a quiet desk, a power socket, and a wireless network __36__ is free to everyone. Some critics argue that a library without books has lost its purpose, but so far the opposite __38__ true: branches that added desks and sockets also lent more books than before. The service matters most to __39__ who have no quiet room of their own. __40__ the shelves are shorter than they used to be, most libraries report more visitors than at any time in the past twenty years.

questions.stem:
【閱讀測驗（一）】請依下文回答第 41～45 題。

In 1945, an American engineer named Percy Spencer was standing beside a machine that produced radar waves. He noticed that a chocolate bar in his pocket had melted. It was a warm room, and most people would have thought no more about it, but Spencer had spent years working with such machines and was curious.

He tried again the next day, this time with a bag of corn kernels. They popped. He then placed an egg near the machine, and it burst. Within a year his company had built a cooking box that used the same waves. It stood almost six feet tall, weighed as much as a small car, and cost more than most families earned in a year. Only restaurants and ships bought it.

The machine that sits in kitchens today took another twenty years to arrive. What changed was not the science, which was understood from the start, but the price of the parts. By 1975, more American homes had a microwave oven than a dishwasher. Spencer himself received two dollars for the patent, the standard payment his company made to any employee who invented something.

第 41 題：What did Percy Spencer first notice in 1945?
options: A bag of corn kernels had started to pop.
An egg placed near the machine had burst.
A chocolate bar in his pocket had melted.
The radar machine had stopped working.
questions.explain: 第一段：He noticed that **a chocolate bar in his pocket had melted**。B、C 是他**隔天**做的實驗（第二段），不是最初的發現；D 文中未提。⚠ 題目問 first noticed，注意時序——文章第二段開頭 the next day 就是分界。

questions.point: 閱讀二：細節（作者認為的主因）
questions.stem:
【閱讀測驗（二）】請依下文回答第 46～50 題。

A washing machine bought in 1975 was expected to last twenty years, and when it broke, the owner called a repairman. Today the same appliance lasts about seven, and the repairman is difficult to find. This is often blamed on falling quality, but the more important change is a different one: many products are now built in a way that makes repair impractical rather than impossible.

Parts are glued instead of screwed. Diagnostic codes are kept private. A component that costs two dollars may be sold only as part of a module costing eighty. None of this is illegal, and none of it is strictly necessary; it is simply cheaper for the manufacturer, and the cost is passed to the owner in a form that does not appear on the price tag.

Several governments have begun to respond. New rules require makers to supply spare parts for a fixed number of years and to publish repair manuals. Manufacturers warn that prices will rise. Repair shops, which had been closing for two decades, report that the phone has started ringing again.

第 46 題：According to the author, what is the more important reason appliances are no longer repaired?
options: Their overall quality has fallen sharply.
They are designed in ways that make repair impractical.
Owners prefer to buy new models more often.
Repairmen have moved into better-paid work.
questions.explain: 第一段末句：this is often blamed on falling quality, **but the more important change** is that products are built in a way that **makes repair impractical rather than impossible**。B 正是作者明白指為次要的說法；C、D 文中未提。⚠ **文章明說「常被歸咎於 X，但更重要的是 Y」時，X 必是誘答**。
